_comment: Pinned program for the multi-clip READ_TEXT READOUT query 'What number does the scorer wear?' on the best-goal clip. Exercises the read_text -> answer op-path (the answer step's `texts` dispatch, primitives.py _answer_text) the hero chain never hits as a final binding. The bound best-goal_cache.json carries read_text[p_seven] = {text:'7'}, so the answer reads back '7'. Window 8000-13000 @ fps 8 (stride 125) samples ts 9000 where p_seven is detected and crop->read_text resolves the pin. Validates against ../schema/dsl.schema.json.
